item.title: Sleeth Gallery hosts final exhibit of semester; closing reception Dec. 9 - West Virginia Wesleyan College
item.description: West Virginia Wesleyan College’s Sleeth Gallery campus will host a closing reception tonight, Dec. 9 from 4:30 to 6 p.m. for Tracked Prints/Layered Sounds: Expanded. An artist talk will immediately follow. The exhibit runs through Dec. 16.
